figures.caption: Tē 73 tô:—Khong-khì ê lō͘, kap si̍t-bu̍t ê lō͘, kái-phò tô͘: KH, khong-khì ê lō͘, chiū-sī ēng ū chat ê chìn lâi chí-bêng; SB, si̍t-bu̍t ê lō͘, chiū-sī ēng bô chat ê chìn lâi chí-bêng. 1, phīⁿ-khang; 2, ian-thâu; 3, hōe-iàm; 4, âu-thâu; 5, khì-kńg; 6, chia̍h-tō; 7, chui-khang; 8, nńg-chhùi-kòa; 9, tē jī kēng-chui-kut; 10, chi̍h. (From Ritchie's “Human Physiology,” World Book Co.)
